task.title: Creating a repository by using Skopeo
task.shortdesc: To create a repository in Red Hat Quay when Podman cannot pull an artifact type, you can use the skopeo copy command to copy the artifact from a source registry.

ul.li: You have installed the skopeo CLI.

You have logged in to a source registry (in this example, \registry.redhat.io) and have a valid authentication file (~/.docker/config.json). Alternatively, you can provide credentials by using the --src-username and --src-password parameters when running a command with the skopeo CLI.
You have logged in to your Red Hat Quay repository.
Depending on the size of your AI/ML artifact, you might have to prepare your registry to accept large artifacts.

context.p: In some cases, the podman CLI tool is unable to pull certain artifact types, for example, application/x-mlmodel, or other AI/ML artifacts. Attempting to use podman pull with this artifact type results in the following error:
context.codeblock: Error: parsing image configuration: unsupported image-specific operation on artifact with type "application/x-mlmodel"
context.p: As an alternative, you can use skopeo copy to copy an artifact from one location to your Red Hat Quay repository.

step.cmd: Use the skopeo copy command on an artifact to copy the artifact to your Red Hat Quay repository. For example:

dlentry.dd: Specifies that SSL/TLS verification for the destination registry is disabled. This parameter is optional.
Specifies that all image manifests are copied, including multi-architecture images. This parameter is optional.
Specifies the source registry credentials. This parameter is optional. If you are not logged into a registry, you can pass in the source registry credentials with these parameters.
Specifies the path to your Docker authentication file. Typically located at ~/.docker/config.json. This parameter is optional.
Specifies your Red Hat Quay registry username and password.
Specifies the source image or artifact from the Red Hat container registry. Ensure that you are logged in to the registry and that you can pull the image.

dd.p: Specifies the URL of your Red Hat Quay repository appended with a namespace and the name of the image.
